records.summary: Introduces StateAct, a code-first computer-use harness that manipulates program state directly and delegates screenshot-and-click subgoals to a GUI agent. An independent completion gate checks saved outputs, while fresh subagents handle subgoals to limit accumulated context.

records.name: SeekJudge: A Practical Reward Framework for Reinforcement Learning in Computer-Use Agents
records.summary: Introduces SeekJudge, which iteratively searches and analyzes GUI trajectories to assess instruction fulfillment. The work combines dense judgment-data synthesis, a step-label benchmark, and reward-server scheduling to study accurate and practical reward feedback for agent training.

records.name: Scaling GUI Agents with Visual State Transitions
records.summary: Introduces State Transition Pretraining, which jointly learns to infer actions from GUI changes and predict future states from current screens and actions. Subsequent instruction-trajectory fine-tuning tests whether these representations transfer to desktop and mobile agent tasks.

records.name: Falsifiable Commitment Planning for Self-Correcting Web Agents
records.summary: Introduces FCPAgent, which attaches confirming and falsifying evidence to each skill-grounded plan step. A plan–test–repair loop checks actions and observations, then localizes contradictions so execution, skills, or plans can be revised at the appropriate level.

records.name: Interactive Reward Agent: GUI Task Evaluation via Environment-State Verification
records.summary: Introduces an Interactive Reward Agent that proposes completion conditions and verifies them using system, application, and GUI tools after execution. GUI-RewardBench provides annotated desktop trajectories for evaluating these evidence-based judgments and their use in reinforcement learning.

records.name: Desktop-Delta Bench: Do Computer-Use Models Understand Desktop GUI Transitions?
records.summary: Introduces Desktop-Delta Bench, an offline diagnostic of GUI transition understanding using temporal-ordering tasks and before/after action inference. It includes decoy observations to test whether models track the source and task relevance of screen changes.

records.name: OmegaUse-OfficeVal: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Long-Horizon Office-Suite Tasks with Economic Grounding
Echoverse: Deep, Evolving Environments for Training Computer-Use Agents at Scale
records.summary: Introduces Echoverse, which compiles specifications into stateful applications with database-grounded graders and uses rollouts to improve both the environments and agent policies. It examines behavioral depth, targeted interface practice, and environment repair as sources of training value.

records.name: Qwen-UI-Agent Technical Report: Toward Next-Generation Real-World Centric Foundation GUI Agents
records.summary: Describes a foundation GUI agent with combined GUI and command-line actions, large-scale interaction infrastructure, and iterative environment and task generation.

records.name: How Benchmarks Mis-Score Computer-Use Agents
records.summary: Audits failure-scored computer-use trajectories to distinguish agent errors from broken tasks and evaluator false negatives. It organizes reliability issues across task construction, trajectory evidence, scoring, and reporting, then derives corresponding evaluation design practices.

records.name: Why Are GUI Agents Correct but Late? Decode on the Decision-Time Critical Path, Tested with Pre-Compiled Policy Trees
records.summary: Introduces Adaptive Anticipatory Policy Trees, which precompute guarded actions and deadlines during idle periods so transient GUI events can be handled without new text generation. Paired experiments examine when this prepared execution helps and when reactive control remains preferable.

records.name: Rethinking Inference-Time Scaling in Local Computer-Use Agents: Failure Modes and Compute Tradeoffs
records.summary: Examines inference-time scaling for local computer-use models by varying context, step budgets, decomposition, and parallel execution. OSWorld experiments track both task performance and changing failure modes, exposing cases where extra computation extends errors or adds coordination overhead.

records.name: OSReward: Instituting Standardized Evaluation for Cross-Platform Computer-Use Reward Models
records.summary: Introduces OSReward and its harder and multidimensional variants for assessing judgments of computer-use trajectories. It also releases a reasoning-annotated judgment corpus and trains reward models, examining reliability, leniency bias, and evaluation cost.

records.summary: Evaluates environmental injection risks in Android tasks using programmatic risk checks and model-based adjudication of ambiguous cases.

records.summary: Studies whether text-embedding GUI grounding scores reflect semantic matching or recovery of visible labels. Same-screen ranking comparisons with lexical baselines expose differences between deployable fusion, oracle selection, and performance on label-poor targets.

records.name: Beyond Success and Failure: Length-Aware Contrastive Learning for GUI Agents
records.summary: Introduces LACL-GUI, a contrastive learning objective that distinguishes trajectory quality within both successful and failed GUI executions. It favors concise successes and uses divergence from successful trajectories to differentiate failures during policy optimization.

records.name: GUI-Primitives: Diagnosing Spatial Reasoning Failures in Vision-Language GUI Grounding
records.summary: Introduces GUI-Primitives, a paired-instruction benchmark that changes a spatial relation while holding the screenshot and anchor fixed. Its diagnostics separate failure to localize either candidate from failure to choose the candidate satisfying the relation.

records.name: Training Needs Trustworthy Worlds: Verified Synthetic Web Environments for Agent Learning
records.summary: Builds synthetic websites with verified navigation, backend state, and feasible tasks to provide reliable supervision for web-agent training.

records.name: Spine-Branch Coordination for Multi-agent Computer Use
CONTRAMEM: Learning Self-Evolving Procedural Memory from Contrasting Multi-Model Trajectories
CausalCache: Conditional High-Fidelity Restoration for Long-Horizon GUI Agents
records.summary: Introduces CausalCache, which selects archived screenshots to restore alongside text summaries under a fixed visual-memory budget. A history-gated adapter processes restored images, with evaluation distinguishing standard step limits from longer-horizon and mobile-transfer settings.

records.name: GSAR: Goal-State-Anchor Rewards for Mobile GUI Agents with Self-Evolving Data Synthesis
records.summary: Introduces GSAR, which synthesizes GUI tasks and successful goal states, then annotates task-relevant interface elements as reward anchors. These anchors support offline trajectory verification and online policy training.

records.name: Reflection with Action-Induced Visual Differences for Desktop GUI Agents
records.summary: Introduces Evidence-First Reflection, which separates extraction of action-induced screen changes from judgment of whether an operation achieved its objective. It filters visual differences into relevant evidence before a desktop agent’s reflector decides how execution should continue.

records.name: WebMCP-Phalanx: Enforcing and Characterizing Trust Boundaries for Browser-Integrated LLM Agents
records.summary: Proposes WebMCP-Phalanx, a browser-integrated runtime that binds page-exposed tools to their registering principals and separates content inspection from privileged invocation. It studies lifecycle and prompt-injection attacks, including a timing bypass that motivates validating all visible metadata before tool use.

records.name: Are Android GUI Agents Robust Against Runtime Anomalies? AnTrap: Evaluating Agents in Dynamic Adversarial Environments
records.summary: Introduces AnTrap, which injects task-solvable runtime anomalies into Android GUI-agent trajectories using a layered failure taxonomy. It compares model robustness and adversarial reinforcement learning to distinguish recoverable interface traps from persistent contextual failures.

records.name: Task-Adaptive Rubrics for GUI Reward Modeling
records.summary: Introduces AdaptRubric, which retrieves reusable criteria for a GUI task family and then generates instruction-specific checks for concrete values and constraints. It evaluates these adaptive rubrics in offline reward assessment and online agent optimization.

records.name: Game2World Engine: Unlocking In-the-Wild Gameplay Videos for World Model Training
BrowserForge: Scaling Web Episode via Parallel Browser Sandboxes
records.summary: Introduces BrowserForge, which combines broad website sourcing, parallel browser sandboxes, and task-proposer/solver interaction to collect verified web trajectories. The pipeline uses page structure during synthesis but trains a policy that acts from screenshots.

LocalLSTC: A Long Short-Term Control Architecture for Locally Deployed GUI Agents
records.summary: Introduces LocalLSTC, a training-free control architecture that maintains persistent task state and uses it to form short execution commitments. Outcomes feed back into that state for progress checks, recovery, and termination in locally deployed desktop agents.

records.name: GameWAM: A World Action Model for Video Games
ADeptS-Bench: Measuring the Trustworthiness of Computer Use Agents Across Devices
records.summary: Evaluates interface-embedded threats and whether computer-use agents seek clarification when mobile or desktop instructions are ambiguous.

records.name: Benchmarking General Mobile Assistants in Challenging Real-World Scenarios
WM-R1: Training GUI Agents to Reason and leverage World Models with Reinforcement Learning
records.summary: Uses learned world models for mobile-agent training rollouts and for reasoning about the consequences of candidate GUI actions.

records.name: CURA: Certified Runtime Alarms for Computer-Use Agents
records.summary: Introduces CURA, a telemetry-based runtime monitor that turns computer-use trajectories into sequential failure alarms and can trigger mid-task oversight. Its certificate controls false alarms, while the study separately reports detection performance and limits of retrospective monitoring.

records.name: Iron: Intent-Aligned and Retrospective Dual Learning Framework for Enhancing Generalist Virtual Agents
records.summary: Introduces Iron, a GUI-agent training framework that aligns low-level actions with high-level intent using cycle-consistency rewards. It also repurposes failed trajectories through hindsight reconstruction and evaluates transfer to other digital tasks.

records.name: Accelerated S-NFC for Million-Chaff RCS Computation Using Low-Rank Compression of Concatenated Block Rows
Learning Simple Test-Time Environments for LLM Web Agents
records.summary: Introduces Test-Time Environment Decomposition, which uses trial interaction to break complex web observations into simpler modules. A label-free adaptation procedure learns from these sub-environments and studies whether their gains compose in full web tasks.

records.name: ActReal: System-Level Mobile Agents Challenge Mobile Automation Detection
records.summary: Introduces ActReal, which translates semantic mobile-agent actions into coordinated touch and sensor signals to study automation-detection weaknesses. It evaluates detectors that observe touch events alone or together with inertial measurements under a privileged executor threat model.

records.name: SIR: Self-improving Red-teaming for Compute Use Agents
records.summary: Introduces SIR, which iteratively refines a reusable library of prompt-injection strategies from failed computer-use attack trajectories. Its evaluation uses deterministic system-state checks and counts attacks only when the adversarial objective and legitimate task both complete.

records.name: UI-Venus-2 Technical Report
records.summary: Describes a GUI foundation agent trained through expanded environments, function-grounded tasks, and trajectory verification with safety-aware execution mechanisms.

records.name: GUI-CC: Benchmarking Contextual Consistency of GUI World Models as Agent Environments
records.summary: Introduces GUI-CC, a benchmark for assessing GUI world models as multi-step agent environments. Separate reference-action and agent-loop tracks test whether generated screens preserve context, plausible transitions, and task progress throughout interaction.

records.name: Are We There Yet? Assessing Computer-Use Agents for Blind Users' Accessible Interaction with Desktop Applications
records.summary: A diary study deploys the screen-reader-accessible OLLA computer-use prototype with blind users across desktop applications. Recorded commands and interaction traces support model comparisons and analysis of grounding, planning, constraint tracking and termination failures.

records.summary: Studies how mobile automation can combine authentication factors within one agent environment and evaluates motion sensing as a user-presence signal.

Do GUI Agents Know When Not to Act? Enabling Conflict-Aware Termination for Multimodal GUI Agents
ElderBench: Benchmarking Autonomous Mobile Agents for Older Adults
records.summary: ElderBench evaluates mobile GUI agents on smartphone requests elicited from older adults, including indirect and underspecified language. Online and offline tests, instruction normalization and linguistic analyses examine how these request patterns contribute to failures.

records.name: From Interaction Traces to Persistent Skills: Online Evolution for Computer-Use Agents
records.summary: An online skill-evolution framework turns GUI interaction traces and evaluator feedback into a versioned library of reusable procedures without updating model parameters. Controlled OSWorld comparisons examine both the benefits of shared procedural memory and its domain-dependent instability under repeated revision.

records.name: CUA-Universe: A Scalable and Dynamic Environment for Hybrid GUI+CLI Agents
records.summary: Turns desktop applications into reproducible GUI-and-CLI environments and generates verified hybrid trajectories for agent post-training.

records.name: SCAFFOLD: Self-Improving Web Agents via Recursive Parametric Skill Abstraction
records.summary: Introduces SCAFFOLD, which extracts executable skills from web trajectories, composes them into a hierarchy, and compresses redundant skills through behavioral checks. It periodically distills skill-guided trajectories into the policy and studies repeated improvement across web benchmarks.

records.name: When and What to Teach: Budget-Aware Online Adaptation for Web Agents
records.summary: Proposes an online teaching framework that decides which web-agent episodes warrant a stronger teacher and which trajectory turns merit training. A solvability gate and score-guided trimming aim to preserve first-attempt performance while reducing teaching and training costs.

records.summary: ERPBench evaluates screenshot-only agents in enterprise software using database values to check the business records produced by their actions. records.summary: Introduces CAVEAT, a controlled marketplace benchmark for testing whether delegated agents preserve user objectives when interfaces favor other outcomes. CaptchaArena: A Large-Scale, Fine-Grained Dataset for Training Computer-Use Agents on Interactive CAPTCHAs
records.summary: Introduces CaptchaArena, a dataset of execution-verified interactive CAPTCHA solutions with screenshot–action trajectories, reasoning annotations, and pixel masks for irregular targets. The work trains a single policy across CAPTCHA types using supervised learning followed by verifier-reward reinforcement learning.

records.name: ScreenHaystack: Finding Blind Zones in GUI Grounding
records.summary: Moves controlled target icons across high-resolution interfaces to diagnose spatial blind zones in grounding models and study targeted augmentation.

records.name: REBASE: Device-Cloud Experience Coherence for GUI Agents Across App Updates
records.summary: Introduces REBASE, a device–cloud protocol for repairing cached GUI experience after app updates. It combines cloud replay, device-side step verification, and progressively richer failure reports to produce repairs tied to application versions.

records.name: PastForward: Faster On-Device GUI Agents via Computational Experience Reuse
records.summary: Introduces PastForward, which reuses earlier output sequences as verified decoding proposals and starts future action computation from predicted GUI transitions. Screen checks determine whether speculative computation and cached model states can be retained.

records.name: From Trajectories to Grounded Preferences: Process Preference Synthesis via Interaction Element Graphs for Web PRMs
records.summary: Introduces SURFPRM, which turns web demonstrations into an interaction-element graph for synthesizing grounded negative actions. Its contrastive preference data trains process reward models to distinguish plausible on-page alternatives and guide downstream trajectory search.

records.name: DashAct: A Progressive Diagnostic Benchmark for GUI Agents in Interactive Dashboard Analysis
records.summary: Diagnoses dashboard-agent failures by progressively restoring interaction context, next-action support, and visual target information within the same task.

records.name: CUA-SWE: When Computer-Use Agents Meet Visual Software Engineering
records.summary: Introduces CUA-SWE, a benchmark and execution environment that combines code changes with graphical interaction and visual inspection of running software. Task-specific tests verify repairs and changes whose required information may be available only through the application interface.

records.name: The GUI Is Not the State: Diagnosing State Aliasing in GUI World Models
records.summary: Introduces StateAliasBench to isolate GUI world-model ambiguities in which matching visible screens and actions can lead to different futures. It augments frozen world models with structured state recovered from interaction history and evaluates the effect on prediction and agent execution.

records.name: CUA-Sandbox: Efficient Environments for Computer-Use Agent Reinforcement Learning
records.summary: Introduces CUA-Sandbox, which separates each rollout’s mutable state from shared initialized software runtimes. State-scoped execution and transactional resets or branches aim to reduce training-environment costs while retaining original interfaces and evaluators.

records.name: AgentTell: Behavioural Side-Channel Leakage in Browser-Use Agents
records.summary: Introduces AgentTell, a benchmark for privacy leakage through browser actions after an agent learns a private fact on another website. It examines whether agents choose revealing options despite nondisclosure instructions and whether their final reports accurately describe that behavior.

records.name: Relevance Does Not Imply Applicability: Experience Activation for Personal GUI Agents
records.summary: Introduces ExpActivator, which matches the current GUI state to relevant historical states before supplying past actions as guidance. A separate activation rule decides whether a recurring user intent is warranted by the current time and situation or should be withheld.

records.name: Probe to Act: Elevating Browser-Use Agent via Active Visual Probing
records.summary: Introduces Probe to Act, which lets browser agents request visual evidence linking DOM handles and screen regions before committing an operation. It retains selected interaction evidence as memory and studies both prompted use and distillation into open models.

records.name: GUITAR: Structured Failure Diagnosis of GUI Agents via State Transitions
records.summary: Introduces GUITAR, which groups visually different screens into functional states and analyzes agent failures over a state-transition graph. It uses the resulting bottlenecks to diagnose recurring mobile and web errors and evaluate targeted guidance.

records.name: Same Tasks, Different Apps: Why Mobile GUI Agents Fail to Generalize?
records.summary: Introduces AnyAppBench, a live Android benchmark that holds user goals fixed while changing the application used to achieve them. It combines category-controlled task pairs with failure annotations to distinguish task understanding from application-specific execution skill.

records.name: One Rollout Is All You Get: Fully Test-Time Adaptation for GUI Agents
records.summary: Defines a test-time adaptation setting with one counted attempt per arriving GUI task and no ground-truth feedback. Its SOLO method filters or relabels completed episodes, then updates a small adapter from a short window of the agent’s own experience.

records.name: LongPuzzleBench: Evaluating GUI Agents on Long-Horizon Visual Puzzles
Before Acting, Change the State: Prospective State Intervention for Web Agents under Deceptive Interfaces
records.summary: Introduces Veer, a runtime defense that changes task-relevant web state when an otherwise valid proposed action would produce an unauthorized consequence. It plans a prospective intervention and grounds and verifies its execution before the base agent continues.

records.name: WebPageBench: Event-Level Verification and Controlled UI-Variant Generation for Web Agents
records.summary: Verifies web tasks through typed interface events and generates controlled UI variations while preserving instructions and success conditions.

records.name: Computational Complexity of Clifford Template Compilation: Are Quantum Computers Useful for Compiling Quantum Circuits?
PhoneCLI: From App Interfaces to Callable Commands for Mobile Agents
records.summary: Introduces PhoneCLI, which explores mobile app interfaces and compiles navigation paths into reusable commands without internal app APIs or instrumentation. At execution time it verifies compiled paths and falls back to a visual agent for open-ended interaction or failed navigation.

records.name: SPECTRA: On-Device Cognitive Perturbation and Trajectory Analysis for Autonomous Edge-Cloud GUI Grounding
Constructing Challenging Browser-Use Tasks by Controlled Environment Interventions
Structured Interaction, Visual Localization, and Robust Execution for Complex Web Tasks: A Technical Report on the WebRetriever Challenge
records.summary: Describes a WebRetriever agent that combines semantic webpage operations with visual localization when structured representations are insufficient. Hierarchical context management and fault-aware execution support processing tasks across concurrent browsers.

records.name: SCOUT: Synergizing Reasoning and Tool-Use for Computer-Use Safety
records.summary: Introduces SCOUT, a safety verifier that first derives task-specific completion and safety rubrics from a computer-use trajectory, then actively probes the resulting environment for evidence. It evaluates whether these two stages detect harmful consequences that screenshots alone can miss.

records.name: AdaptArena: Evaluating Test-Time Personalization of Web Agents
records.summary: Introduces AdaptArena to test whether web agents can infer unstated user preferences from relevant past trajectories and carry those preferences into new tasks. Its AdaptiveAgent baseline separates preference-retrieval challenges from failures in downstream web execution.

records.name: PrecogUI: Proactive GUI Agents via Pre-cognitive Simulation and Experience Retrieval
records.summary: Presents PrecogUI, which retrieves prior anomaly and success patterns and predicts symbolic UI transitions before choosing actions. It also introduces InterfereBench, generated for evaluating long GUI workflows with disruptive events and recovery requirements.

records.name: Neuro-Symbolic Computer Use: Learning Reusable Policies for Reliable and Efficient Execution
records.summary: Learns reusable computer-use policies that encode stable workflow logic in programs while delegating grounding and state checks to neural models. Policy iteration executes variants, diagnoses failures, revises the program, and adds verification before state-changing actions.

records.name: SCA: Spatial Credit Assignment for Reinforcement Learning of GUI Agents
records.summary: Introduces Spatial Credit Assignment, which uses click coordinates to refine group-relative reinforcement-learning updates for GUI grounding. It distinguishes failed clicks by spatial evidence while leaving the deployed action policy unchanged.

records.name: MatToolBench: Benchmarking Multimodal Agents in Real-World Materials Science Workflows
records.summary: Introduces MatToolBench, a Windows-based materials-science benchmark combining GUI operation, scientific-software scripting, and database queries. Expert-defined subcriteria support partial-credit scoring, while the evaluation examines domain knowledge gaps and cross-tool handoff failures.

records.name: Absorbed in Inertia: Activation Analysis for Computer-Use Agents
records.summary: Studies repetitive, unproductive actions in desktop agents through their internal activation states. It proposes Reset, Reroute, Restore, a context intervention that temporarily resets an agent’s trajectory and later restores it to help escape repeated ineffective behavior.

records.name: EngiWorld: What Can Frontier Agents Deliver in Professional Engineering Environments?
records.summary: Introduces professional engineering tasks across software domains, with GUI and CLI access and artifact checks for geometric, physical, and design validity.

records.name: HybridCUA: Learning to Orchestrate GUI and CLI for Computer-Use Agents
records.summary: Trains computer agents on verified GUI, command-line, and interleaved trajectories to learn when and how to combine interaction modes.

records.name: RealGUINoise: An Interactive Cross-Platform Benchmark for GUI Agent Robustness under Real-World Interface Noise
records.summary: Evaluates interactive GUI agents under varied realistic interface noise, comparing task completion, safety, and behavior with clean-environment runs.

records.name: SimTrace: Grounded Multimodal User Trajectories Generation for Online User Modeling
Action Conditioned Bisimulation For GUI Agent Memory
records.summary: Defines a GUI-memory merge rule that treats two states as equivalent only when shared actions lead to matching outcomes and successor states. The training-free method replaces observation-similarity merging and is tested in closed-loop MiniWoB++ interaction.

records.name: Talk2Agent: Benchmarking Voice Interfaces for Text Agents
records.summary: Introduces Talk2Agent, a benchmark of spoken instructions for computer-use tasks that measures whether voice interfaces preserve task-critical information. It pairs human speech with an execution-free intention-based metric and checks how that metric relates to downstream task completion.

records.name: ReSAIL: Mitigating Collapse in Iterative Agent Self-Distillation
Learning Reliable GUI Agents under Imperfect Priors
records.summary: Combines structured GUI exploration with training designed to tolerate imperfect retrieved experience. It builds state-transition graphs and synthetic task trajectories, then injects realistic forms of interface drift so agents learn when to rely on or reject prior guidance.

records.name: OSWorld-Science: A Benchmark of Computer Use Agents for Learning and Using Scientific Software
records.summary: Benchmarks computer agents on scientific-software workflows with task-specific checks of application states and generated research artifacts.

records.name: ComputerSD: Online Self-Distillation from Real-Time Feedback for Computer-Use Agents
records.summary: Introduces ComputerSD, which turns feedback from executed GUI transitions into online self-distillation guidance and step-level scores. A GUI analyzer supplies these signals, which are combined with trajectory-level reinforcement learning in asynchronous training.

records.name: cua-speedrun: Standardized Benchmarking of the Speed of Computer-Use Agents
records.summary: Standardizes virtual machines, interaction pipelines, and agent interfaces to compare computer-use speed, cost, and task performance.

records.name: Zengram-Lite: An In-Browser Agentic-Memory Framework - Semantic Knowledge, Session Tracking, and Token-Budgeted Context
ZoneClaw: Mitigating Persistent Memory Attacks by Establishing Memory-Zoning in OpenClaw-Style Computer-Use Agents
GUI-HARVEST: Self-Improving GUI Agents through Evidence-Driven Harness Evolution
records.summary: Improves GUI-agent execution code by analyzing action effects and repeated-task failures, then validating bounded changes with frozen model weights.

records.name: AutoGUIWorld: Image Generators as Visual World Models for GUI Agent
records.summary: Introduces AutoGUIWorld, which combines task planning and image editing to synthesize action-grounded GUI trajectories without running the depicted software. It filters generated transitions and tests whether training on them improves agents operating real desktop and scientific applications.

records.name: Auditing Web Agent Evaluation on WebArena-Lite: Human Review of Outcomes and Trajectories
records.summary: Audits WebArena-Lite outcomes and trajectories with human review to identify automatic-evaluator false negatives and the first consequential execution errors. It also studies explicit execution-state memory and procedural guidance, showing why final task scores can miss substantial differences in agent behavior.

records.name: Not All Experience Belongs in the Weights: Component Routing for Self-Improving GUI Agents
records.summary: Studies how to route different parts of GUI experience into model weights or runtime context rather than treating whole trajectories as a single unit. It separates locators, procedures, state facts, and lessons, then predicts their destination from recurrence and dependence on the current state.

records.name: DeskForge: Dense Supervision from Desktop Environments for Computer-Use Agents
records.summary: Generates dense desktop supervision by varying real application scenes and combining screenshots, accessibility trees, and window geometry.

records.name: When to Compile a Computer-Use Agent? Measuring Payback and Making Compilation Decisions for Token Efficiency
records.summary: Introduces PACE, a protocol and online decision rule for deciding when repeated GUI procedures are worth compiling into programs. It accounts for failed compilation attempts, measured per-use savings, uncertain reuse, and execution costs under an explicit cumulative budget.

records.name: WebFovea: When the Model Is Right but the Click Is Wrong -- Reliable Round Trips for Vision-Based Web Agents on Live Websites
records.summary: Describes WebFovea, a vision-based live-web agent whose execution loop checks action parsing, browser effects, feedback accuracy, and observation delivery. The report analyzes failures such as coordinate mismatches and silent control interactions and documents corresponding harness changes.

records.name: Securing Computer-Use Agents Against Branch Steering Attacks
records.summary: Introduces STEER-Bench to study branch-steering attacks that manipulate untrusted web data toward hazardous paths already permitted by an agent’s plan. Its COBRA architecture combines trusted branching plans with advance constraints on the parameters and destinations each branch can use.

records.name: HyperBrowseComp: A Multilingual and Multimodal Stress Test for Web-Browsing Agents
Control OSWorld: An AI Control Environment for GUI Computer Use Agents
records.summary: Pairs OSWorld tasks with harmful side objectives to evaluate monitors that detect malicious behavior in computer-use agent trajectories.

records.name: CUAWright: A Minimal Unified Interface for Digital Agents
records.summary: Studies a minimal terminal-based execution framework that lets digital agents construct tools and manage context across browser, desktop, and CAD tasks.

records.name: MedImageOSWorld: Benchmarking GUI Agents for Medical Image Consoles
records.summary: Evaluates GUI agents in simulated medical-imaging consoles, separately checking workflow completion and acquisition outcomes against hidden anatomical targets.

records.name: Scaling Verifiable Environments for Long-horizon Work Agents
Recurrent Latent Visual Search for GUI Grounding
records.summary: Introduces ReLaViS, which performs recurrent visual search inside a grounding model by repeatedly querying screenshot tokens and feeding the resulting spatial evidence back into the model. Coarse-to-fine supervision is constructed from existing interface-element annotations.

records.name: TeleTune: Evolving Agent Skills From Offline Telemetry
records.summary: Introduces TeleTune, which edits a textual skill library using held-out action prediction on offline software-use logs with missing goals or interleaved tasks. The learned workflows also guide retrieval of demonstrations for subsequent web-agent execution.

records.name: Imagine to Act: High-Fidelity Data Synthesis via Image Editing World Model for Scalable GUI Agent Training
records.summary: Introduces Infinite-Dreamer, which learns action-conditioned screenshot editing from structured descriptions of GUI changes and uses it to synthesize robustness examples and multi-step trajectories. The synthetic data trains a mobile GUI agent evaluated on AndroidWorld, MobileWorld, and AndroidControl-Curated.

records.name: CLIFT: Conformal Self-Verification for Web Agent Training and Test-Time Scaling
records.summary: Introduces CLIFT, which certifies agent-generated verification signals against training-time judges and reuses them for per-step rewards and trajectory selection. At inference, a frozen question bank helps compare candidate web rollouts without querying an external judge.

records.name: AMBER: Training Long-Horizon Web Agents through Append-Only Memory
records.summary: Introduces AMBER, an append-only memory framework in which a web agent learns to reason, act, and retain evidence using outcome-reward reinforcement learning. It studies whether preserving entries avoids the loss of facts and corrective feedback seen with rewritten memory.

records.name: PlaySuite: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Interactive Visual Intelligence
Decoupling What from Where: How Should a Small GUI Grounding Model Receive the Action Type?
records.summary: Compares ways to condition a small GUI grounding model on action type under matched training conditions on Android in the Wild. The study traces apparent gains to a coordinate-serialization choice and reports limited evidence that the gains persist with predicted action types.

records.name: Can Agents Work for Everyone? Cross-User Reliability for Mobile GUI Agents in Personalized User Interfaces
records.summary: Introduces PAIR for controlled evaluation of mobile GUI agents across user-conditioned application states and RePAIR for training from cross-user subgoal outcomes. The study examines failures when personalized interfaces change which items an agent must identify.

records.name: nanoMuse: An Open-Source Personal Agent for Every Device You Own
AdvSim2Real : Training Web Agents Against Adaptive Prompt Injection in a Web World Model
records.summary: Presents AdvSim2Real, which jointly adapts web-task curricula, prompt-injection adversaries, and agent policies inside a frozen web world model. It evaluates robustness against an unseen adversary and transfer from simulated interaction to a real browser.

records.name: Adversarial Images Hijack Web Agents from Visual Grounding to Browser Execution
records.summary: Introduces WebMirage, a visual red-teaming framework that models webpage element competition and action post-processing to test whether manipulated grounding decisions lead to executed browser actions.

records.name: Secure-CUA: Controlling Untrusted Influence in Computer-Use Agents
records.summary: Proposes Secure-CUA, which commits to per-action transactions before reading untrusted page content and separates content queries from GUI target selection. The paper formalizes its protection assumptions and evaluates benign task utility on WebArena.

records.name: AgentHorizon: Evaluating Agentic Judges for Long-Horizon Computer-Use Tasks
records.summary: Introduces AgentHorizon, a benchmark for judging long computer-use trajectories using closely related instructions paired with recorded actions and screenshots. It tests whether judges can detect constraint violations and distinguish successful tasks from similar but incompatible requests.

records.name: Harness Evolution Hits a Ceiling: When Weight Training Should Begin
DeltaReplay: Task-Relative Memory Reuse for Mobile GUI Agents
records.summary: Introduces DeltaReplay, which stores mobile GUI trajectories as transition graphs and decides at each step whether to reuse an action, substitute task-specific parameters, or defer to the base agent. This supports reuse of partially matching experiences without rewriting stored memory.

records.name: Right Screen, Wrong Transition: World Models as Verifiers for GUI Agents
records.summary: Presents LGWM, a decoder-free GUI world model that predicts the next screen representation from an action and compares it with the observed state to verify transitions. Its paired diagnostic separates legitimate and hijacked transitions that lead to the same credential screen.

records.name: Multifunctional synaptic learning and neuromorphic computing using crystalline TiO$_x$/NiO$_x$ heterojunction-based memory devices
SoftwareGym: Scaling Computer-Use Agent Training with Diverse Synthesized Software Environments
records.summary: Introduces SoftwareGym, a pipeline that synthesizes runnable GUI applications and iteratively repairs them using execution checks. It also provides a task benchmark and studies whether training on synthesized application trajectories transfers to other computer-use environments.

records.name: When Charts Deceive Web Agents: A Paired Benchmark for Misleading Visualization-Grounded Tasks
records.summary: Introduces MisVisAgentBench, a paired executable benchmark that changes chart evidence while holding web tasks fixed, to trace how misleading visualizations affect agent decisions and downstream actions.

records.name: CaptchaAgent: Verifiable Visual Reasoning for CAPTCHA Solving
records.summary: Presents CaptchaAgent, which builds an explicit visual representation of objects and relations, refines ambiguous regions, and checks counterfactual consistency before acting on interactive CAPTCHAs.

records.name: Work2Skill: Capturing Human GUI Experience for Reusable Agent Skill Induction
records.summary: Aligns human screen recordings, input events, and accessibility information to derive reusable workflow skills from desktop demonstrations.

records.name: ConClick: Element-Wise Contrastive Learning Improves GUI Grounding
records.summary: Analyzes recurring distractor clicks in GUI grounding and introduces ConClick, a contrastive training method built from target–distractor pairs. Its ReClick inference procedure revisits candidate regions and compares competing predictions.

records.name: Web$hell: A Unified Interface for Agentic Web Access
records.summary: Introduces Web$hell, an interface that compiles live pages into persistent information and action objects so agents can gather evidence, navigate websites, and reuse acquired content through shared operations.

records.name: A Baseline Assessment for the Agentic Web Technology Stack
records.summary: Presents MASTIF, a framework for comparing combinations of agent models, protocols, and implementation frameworks on web tasks, with an initial assessment using 300 Mind2Web tasks.

records.name: OpenMobile-2: Building Versatile Mobile Agents with Scalable Environments and App-Native Tools
records.summary: Introduces OpenMobile-2, combining simulated mobile apps, emulator tasks, released training data, and policies that can alternate GUI interaction with app-native tools.

records.name: Latent World Action Model for GUI Agents
records.summary: Replaces future-screenshot generation with a shared latent representation for GUI action selection and action-conditioned transition prediction. An action-aware contrastive objective encourages the transition representation to retain discriminative action-induced changes.

records.name: The Agent Clicks Approve: Injected Page Text Makes Browser Agents Authorize Access the Task Never Named
records.summary: Studies prompt-injected account-access approvals in browser agents and proposes a service-side authority envelope that checks authorization requests against the user task before allowing them to complete.

records.name: A Decade in a Day: Synthesizing Agent-Native Interfaces from Human-Oriented Software Evolution
Seg2Click: Learning Pixel-Level Action Masks for GUI Visual Grounding
records.summary: Recasts GUI grounding as predicting a mask of valid click locations from bounding-box supervision, then derives a click point with a deterministic selection rule.

records.name: HyWe: Unifying Search and Operation for Real-World Hybrid Web Tasks
records.summary: Introduces HyWe, which switches between information search and browser operation within one trajectory, alongside a demonstration pipeline and a benchmark of hybrid web tasks.

records.name: Learn from Move: the Next Step for GUI Agents
records.summary: Introduces LatentGUIWorld to test learning interface semantics and dynamics through interaction, and studies finer movement actions with intermediate visual feedback and exploration demonstrations.

records.name: PrivacyGuard: Source-Linked Sanitization and Locally Resolvable PII References for Cloud GUI Agents
records.summary: Introduces PrivacyGuard, which sanitizes source-linked personal information and maintains locally resolvable references across mobile-agent turns to reduce exposure to remote planners.

records.name: BrowseSafe++: Benchmarking Prompt Injection Detection Across Web Contexts, Languages, and Browser Views
records.summary: Extends BrowseSafe with paired attacked and clean webpages in several representations, and studies text and screenshot detectors plus feedback-adapted prompt injections.

records.name: Adaptive-Group Process Rewards for GUI Agents
records.summary: Groups GUI trajectories by subgoal and combines action-level and group-level assessments into intermediate rewards for training agents with sparse task outcomes.

records.name: MHVF: Training-Free GUI Grounding via Verification-Guided Multi-Hypothesis Search
records.summary: Introduces MHVF, a training-free grounding method that explores several candidate screen regions, verifies them in local views, and uses those checks to guide further search.

records.name: Interaction-as-a-Judge
records.summary: Uses computer-use agents to interact with generated applications, studying whether interaction improves preference judging, requirement checks, and feedback for application generation.

records.name: Learning How to Remember: Memory Modality Selection for GUI Agents
records.summary: Introduces SwitchMem, which chooses a textual or visual representation of retrieved experience at each GUI interaction step instead of fixing one memory modality for a task.

records.name: Towards Safe Autonomy for Computer Use
records.summary: Presents SA-CUA, separating trusted and untrusted visual content using accessibility-derived masking rules and a controlled channel for verifying information before endorsement.

records.name: Pack Light, CarryOn: Building Object-Oriented Context for Long-Horizon Agents
records.summary: Introduces CarryOn, which maintains evidence-linked task objects and remaining-work context across history compression, with evaluations on desktop tasks and web research.

records.name: Tev: Scaling Long-Horizon Agentic Environments with Dense Progress Rewards
GroundGUI: GUI Grounding by High-Quality Data and Distillation-to-Reinforcement Learning

records.name: CLASHarness: Benchmarking Multi-Agent Conflict in Computer Use via a Controllable and Verifiable Generation Pipeline
records.summary: Introduces CLASHarness, generating verifiable computer-use tasks with conflicting agent reports, shared-state constraints, and coordination requirements to evaluate conflict detection and resolution.

records.name: Teaching Agents in their Own Style: Blackbox Teacher Distillation for Web Agents
records.summary: Introduces WebKD, which repairs failed student web-agent trajectories with minimal teacher edits and trains on corrections that preserve the student's reasoning style.

records.name: How GUI Agents Fail: GraceBench for Execution Stability Diagnosis
records.summary: Introduces GraceBench, using application transition graphs and recorded interaction evidence to diagnose deviations, loops, and recovery that final task-success scores can hide.

records.name: Task-State Governance: A Virtual Machine for Verifiable and Recoverable GUI Agent Execution

records.name: Why Generate a Click? Plug-in Decision Heads for Web Agents
records.summary: Adds decision heads to a frozen vision-language generator for selecting web actions and targets, with a confidence gate that falls back to text generation.

records.name: STP-GUI: Spatially-Aware Token Pruning for Efficient Web-GUI Agents

records.name: Player-1: Learning to Play from Synthetic Experience
